key_insight: A pretrained autoregressive LM can be converted into a fast standalone multi-token predictor by using an online self-distillation objective, enabling multi-token generation in one pass without training separate speculator models or changing the model implementation.
problem_solved: Reduces inference latency and deployment complexity caused by slow single-token autoregressive decoding and by approaches (e.g., speculative decoding) that require auxiliary speculator models and complex pipelines.
method: Use the original pretrained model's outputs as targets in an online self-distillation loop so the model learns to predict multiple future tokens in a single forward pass.

Train with a multi-token prediction objective that aligns student multi-token outputs with teacher autoregressive continuations, while preserving the pretrained model architecture and deployment code.
Produce a single standalone model that at inference time emits several tokens per step, avoiding external speculators or pipeline orchestration.
impact: Delivers simpler, faster language-model inference with no additional models or special serving pipelines, making high-throughput deployment and real-time applications easier for practitioners.
